title: Origin Point-Mass under Tanh Generator
intuition: Tests whether a 2D generator ending in a bounded `tanh` activation can contract cleanly onto the origin Dirac point mass (0, 0) within 1,000 updates with zero saturated outputs (saturated_fraction == 0.0).
failure_mode: Overshooting updates slam generator pre-activations into the +/-1 tanh rails where derivatives vanish, leaving saturated samples stuck on the boundary.
protocol_notes: Tier-1 required gate; serves as prerequisite for `zero_tanh_rail_escape`.
